mentions.description: A daily procedural logic puzzle played in the browser. Players set rules onto a small grid of numbers to maximize their score. Recent work focuses on refining difficulty by experimenting with different rule types and improving the UI, aiming to introduce variety without adding complexity.

mentions.name: Ruly
mentions.description: A daily number/logic puzzle played on a grid where players set rules, designed to be simple, procedural, and replayable. It features weekly variations, such as breaking a rule on Saturdays to score maximum points and an added memory aspect on Mondays. Development focuses on game design and testing, with plans for better onboarding/tutorial and a more intuitive UI.
